## Overview
Mount Guiauasan is one of the 26 named mountains in Biliran province, Eastern Visayas, Philippines. Located at coordinates 11°36'36"N 124°28'51"E, the mountain has an elevation of approximately 984-1,100 meters with a prominence of 261 meters. It is part of the mountainous interior that characterizes the main volcanic island of Biliran.

## Geography and Location
Biliran is one of the smallest provinces in the Philippines, featuring mountainous interiors with very narrow coastal areas. Mount Guiauasan is situated among other notable peaks including Mount Maliwatan (1,346m - the highest peak), Mount Suiro (1,301m), Tres Marias Peak (1,270m), Mount Sayao (1,266m), and Mount Lauaan (1,172m).

## Biliran as a Mountaineering Destination
Biliran has been positioned as an emerging mountaineering haven in Eastern Visayas through the 'Climb Biliran' initiative. The province offers unique summit experiences ranging from easy to moderate and challenging levels. Despite its modest size, Biliran is a paradise for nature lovers, with lush mountains, pristine beaches, and captivating waterfalls waiting to be explored.

## Nearby Attractions
Biliran is known as the 'Island of Waterfalls' with over 30 stunning waterfalls throughout the province. Notable waterfalls include Casiawan Falls (130 feet - the highest in Biliran), Ulan-Ulan Falls known for its misty atmosphere, Tinago Falls in Caibiran (90 feet), and Kasabangan Falls Leisure Park with 12 cascades. These make excellent side trips when visiting the mountain regions.

## Famous Mountain Treks in Biliran
Mt. Tres Marias is the most popular hiking destination, featuring three peaks with the tallest at 1,315 meters. The trek involves stream crossings and forest paths, leading through dense rainforests, mossy forests, stunning waterfalls including Sampawan and Ulan-Ulan Falls. Mt. Panamao, an active volcano that last erupted in 1939, is considered sacred by locals.

## How to Get There
The fastest way to reach Biliran is by flying to DZR Airport in Tacloban. From the airport, head to Van Van or Dup Tours Terminal downtown or the Tacloban Grand Terminal and ride a bus or van to Naval (approximately 2.5 hours, around P130). Within Biliran, hire a habal-habal (motorcycle taxi) for transportation, negotiable at around P1,000 for a full day tour.
